name: Fiji
title: Holidays in Fiji
intro: More than 300 South Pacific islands of palm-fringed beaches, soft coral reefs and warm village welcomes. Here's what Fiji is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: The green, rocky peak of Kuata Island in Fiji rising above the sea

facts.label: Time difference
facts.value: 11 to 12 hrs ahead of the UK

facts_note: Cyclone season runs from November to April. Check entry rules on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: May to October is the dry season and best time, with sunny days around 28°C and calm, clear water. November to April is hotter and wetter, with cyclones possible, but it's quieter and cheaper. Fijian school holidays in July and December are busy.

things.name: Mamanuca Islands
things.blurb: Small islands with white beaches and resorts, an easy boat ride from Nadi.

things.name: Yasawa Islands
things.blurb: A remote chain of islands, reached by catamaran, for snorkelling and village visits.

things.name: Coral Coast
things.blurb: The south coast of the main island, with resorts, reefs and sand dunes.

things.name: Diving with sharks
things.blurb: Beqa Lagoon is famous for shark dives.

things.name: Village visit
things.blurb: Join a kava ceremony. Bring a gift of kava root and cover your shoulders.

things.name: Garden of the Sleeping Giant
things.blurb: Orchid gardens in the hills near Nadi.

faqs.question: How do you get to Fiji from the UK?
faqs.answer: Fly to Nadi via Asia, Australia, New Zealand or the USA, usually 24 hours or more in total.

faqs.question: Which Fiji island is best?
faqs.answer: The Mamanucas are easiest to reach. The Yasawas are more remote, and Taveuni suits divers and walkers.

faqs.question: Is Fiji expensive?
faqs.answer: Island resorts can be pricey, but backpacker resorts and the Coral Coast offer cheaper options.

faqs.question: How long should you spend in Fiji?
faqs.answer: Ten days to two weeks, or a week as a stopover on the way to Australia or New Zealand.
